name: Jessica Waterson
source: Jessica recently moved to the city, where she found work as a tattoo artist. It seems she hasn't led the safest and exemplary life, and the wear of her experiences show on her. She's an undeniably attractive girl, one who seemingly had all the opportunities she could want, but who rarely cracks a smile nowadays.
